# v0.9.0b2 — Review fixes, BavarianData 0.9.30 required

Integration only; the app stays at **0.9.0b1**.

- **Breaking: BavarianData 0.9.30 or newer** is required for automatic vehicle
  selection and Virtual Plug & Charge. Its dated **Charging Cable** sensor is
  the only cable source now.
- **Breaking: no automatic cleanup** of the entities folded in 0.9.0b1; delete
  leftover entries in the entity list. No compatibility code before 1.0.
- **Breaking: all phase values on Total power.** While power flows it carries
  the current, voltage and power of L1 to L3 as attributes; the three
  **Current L1–L3** sensors are gone.
- Fixes from the code review: no extra bus reads while a status block is held
  over a failed read, no wallbox write from the unplug switch after an unload,
  a cancelled vehicle change reloads the entry, and a refused percentage
  target is no longer reported as an unreachable service.

[Changelog](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.9.0b2/CHANGELOG.md)
